latif.title: Latif Karimov
latif.description: Latif Karimov, the founder of Azerbaijani carpet studies and a distinguished scholar and carpet artist, played an exceptional role in the establishment, collection development, and growth of the Azerbaijan National Carpet Museum. It was through his initiative that this unique cultural institution was founded in Baku in 1967.
